lockRule: Set lockedAt and the hashes below only after owner approval, a passed phase 1 and an accepted independent protocol review, and before any phase 2 cell. Any change after lock is a new version; earlier versions and their results are retained.
purpose: OS2: whether Context gives better accepted outcomes at lower complete model token cost than a competent ordinary workflow (and optionally Graphify) with the same frontier model in every arm.

buildUnderTest.repinRule: A phase 0 or phase 1 fix ships as its own release; this block is repinned before lock.

taskPack.shape: Eight tasks: four on one ForgeSworn repository and four on one repository outside ForgeSworn; per repository one orientation, impact, diagnosis and code-change task.
taskPack.excluded: The eight d5-20260921 tasks are not reused: both repositories are ForgeSworn and the 0.4.0 fixes were found on that set.
taskPack.hiddenAcceptance: Required evidence, dependency set, checker and scope rules per task, written and hashed by a session that has not designed Context tools, instructions or prompts. Hashes recorded here at lock; contents unread by the tool side until results are recorded.

executor.invocation: absolute binary path with explicit flags, no shell, no inherited aliases

reviewer.blind: does not see arm name or other arms' output
reviewer.receives: answer or diff, checker result, private rubric, bounded excerpts of cited frozen source

arms.plain: Built-in shell, read and edit; no MCP server.
arms.context: As plain, plus the pinned 0.26.0 repository MCP server bound to the arm's prepared root; fresh server per arm.

graphify.description: As plain, plus a graph prebuilt with `graphify update <workspace>` (no model).

retrievalInstructionRule: Each arm's prompt begins with one retrieval instruction of similar length and force.
armOrderRule: Repetition r (1 to 3) of task i (1 to 8) uses the arm order rotated by (i + r - 1) mod n, where n is the number of arms.

steps: Packet sufficiency: deterministic check that a bounded packet holds each task's required evidence; record bytes; uncovered tasks are recorded gaps, not removed.
Transcript metrics on Codex --json streams: readsAfterPacket and toolErrorRate, tested on recorded streams.
Harness tests for rotation, third arm, incomplete usage and the no-alias rule.

writeProbe.purpose: Recheck the v2 read-only sandbox defect on the pinned Codex version.

phase1.cells: one impact or code-change task, plain and context, one repetition, one reviewer each
phase1.onFailure: Record; fix the observed cause as its own release; rerun phase 1 under a new draft revision. Phase 2 is not run.

phase2.cells: 8 tasks x 3 repetitions x 2 or 3 arms, plus one reviewer per cell

metrics.readsAfterPacket: Direct reads (shell cat, sed, rg on a path) of lines already returned by a packet in the same session, divided by packet-covered files.
metrics.toolErrorRate: Error tool results divided by all tool results.
metrics.missedOrIncorrectDependencies: Against the hidden dependency set, by checker and scope check.
metrics.firstPassAccepted: Code-change checker passes on the executor's first self-check.
metrics.totalTokens: Executor plus reviewer input and output, including cached input, setup, repairs and failed attempts.

qualityGate.rule: Per-task median lower than the comparator on at least two tasks and higher on none, with no Context outcome rejected.
qualityGate.perfectBaseline: No claim; a prospectively written harder task class replaces that class.
qualityGate.structuredAcceptance: Checker passed and blind reviewer accepted.

costGate.statistic: Sum over tasks of per-task median totalTokens
costGate.rule: Context at least 20% below each comparator, and sum of per-task median reviewerSeconds no higher.
costGate.reportedOnly: Geometric mean of per-task ratios with a 90% bootstrap interval (10,000 draws, seed fixed at lock).
costGate.accounting: Codex --json event stream usage; cached, uncached, output and reasoning subset reported separately, never added twice.
costGate.incomplete: Missing usage marks a cell incomplete, never zero; an incomplete cell fails the cost gate for its task.
costGate.money: Billing route unknown; cash savings remain unproven.

openDecisions: Author of hidden rubrics and dependency sets
Separate approvals for write probe, phase 1, protocol review and phase 2
